notes.title: Update Notes for December 1st
notes.content:
V2024.12.01
New character attributes added: 
Physical Attack Power, 
Magical Attack Power, 
Physical Defense, 
Magical Defense, 
and adjustments have been made to character attributes;

Corresponding skills have been added for the following characters:
Holy Slime: Holy Explosion upon death, causing area damage.
Arcane Demon: Attacks come with an Arcane Orb effect.
Fire Giant: Attacks come with a Flame Explosion effect, causing area damage.

New characters added:

Orc Warrior,
Armored Orc Warrior,
Orc Mage: Capable of unleashing powerful Fire Rain skills;
Evil Bandit;
Evil Mage: Casts healing spells to assist nearby enemy units.

This is the first independent game I've made and I will try my best to provide updates every weekend. Thank you very much! :)

notes.title: Patch Notes - November 24th
notes.content:
Game Adjustments:

1. Adjusted the monster spawn rates on some maps.

2. Adjusted the cost of some cards.

[u][b]3. Added cooldown to cards: Now, each card will enter a cooldown phase after being used and cannot be used again during this time.[/b][/u]

Bug Fixes:

1. Fixed sound effect bugs for certain characters.

2. Fixed some attack bugs related to skills.

3. Fixed some text bugs.
